title: Trump and Xi Jinping meet in bilateral summit without significant progress on Taiwan
summary: The leaders of the U.S. and China hold a meeting focused on managing rivalry, but avoid delving into the Taiwan issue.

title: Trump rejects Iranian proposal to open Strait of Hormuz and demands nuclear concessions
summary: The U.S. president dismisses Tehran's plan to free the maritime passage and links any dialogue to new demands on its nuclear program.

title: Japan defeats North Korea and advances to semifinals in men's football at Asian Games
summary: The Japanese national team overcomes its North Korean rival in a tense match and secures passage to the next round of the continental tournament.

title: 11-year-old boy wins gold in esports at Asian Games competing in Puyo Puyo
summary: Japanese Kurihara is crowned champion in the video game event, becoming the youngest medalist in the history of the event.

title: Princess Kako visits Tottori, rides steam train and meets centenarian
summary: The member of the Japanese imperial family carries out official duties in the prefecture, including a steam locomotive ride and a visit to a nursing home.

title: Ex-husband of eldest daughter arrested as suspect in murder of woman in Gunma
summary: Police seek the victim's former son-in-law for the murder and attempted murder of her son, after finding a vehicle in his name.

title: Murakami Munetaka goes hitless and White Sox fail to win division title
summary: The Japanese batter fails to get a hit in his at-bat and his team, the Chicago White Sox, is eliminated from the American League pennant race.

title: Typhoon 25 and torrential rains cause flooding and landslides in Chiba, with damage to homes and vehicles
summary: Intense rainfall leaves vehicles submerged and forces evacuations, while car insurance covers millions in losses.

title: Alert for linear precipitation band in Kyushu: evacuation orders issued in Kumamoto
summary: Forecasting systems detect extreme rainfall in several southwestern prefectures, activating highest-level warnings.

title: Political funding scandal shakes Liberal Democratic Party again
summary: New revelations about opaque funds rekindle public distrust and pressure the government to clarify the use of money.
